record.what_it_does: AI meeting recorder that transcribes, summarizes, and shares call notes.
record.auth_notes: The API key is user-scoped. It is created in User Settings > API Access and sent in the X-Api-Key header. It only sees meetings the user recorded or that were shared with them or their team. OAuth 2.0 is for integrations that multiple Fathom accounts install. You register the app via fathom.video/marketplace_applications/new to get a client ID and secret. The token endpoint is https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1/oauth2/token and is limited to 60 requests per 60 seconds per app. The only scope is public_api. Access tokens are short-lived and come with refresh tokens. The OpenAPI spec lists ApiKeyAuth and BearerAuth. OAuth apps cannot use include_summary/include_transcript on /meetings; they must use the /recordings endpoints.
record.access_notes: The FAQ says "API access—keys and webhooks— are included on all plans", which includes Free. OAuth apps need a registration form on Fathom's marketplace. Fathom says OAuth apps are "subject to review", but the docs describe review as a quarterly usage check for listing (20+ users get an invitation), not a gate before other users can authorize. The rate limit is 60 calls/min globally, and heavy summary/transcript calls are capped at 30/min. Per the pricing page, MCP looks tied to paid Team/Premium tiers and limited to work domains.
record.api_breadth_notes: The OpenAPI spec lists 11 operations, base https://api.fathom.ai/external/v1: GET /meetings, GET /meeting_types, GET /recordings/{id}/summary, GET /recordings/{id}/transcript, POST /recordings/{id}/download, GET /recordings/{id}/downloads/{download_id}, GET /teams, GET /team_members, GET /users, POST /webhooks, DELETE /webhooks/{id}. Everything is read-only apart from webhooks and download requests. There are official TypeScript and Python SDKs.
record.mcp_notes: Fathom hosts an MCP server at https://api.fathom.ai/mcp, documented at developers.fathom.ai/mcp-docs with ChatGPT and Claude guides. The pricing page lists MCP under Team/Premium and says "Only for work domains; Max 5 users / domain".
record.blocker_notes: Credentials are self-serve on all plans, and OAuth app registration is a form. The main limit is the small API: 11 mostly read-only operations covering meetings, recordings, teams, users, and webhooks, with no write actions on meetings or notes. Rate limits are tight (60/min, and 30/min for transcripts and summaries). Fathom may review OAuth apps, but the docs don't say review blocks installs.
